description: A roll of 20 turns the ankle about the toe pivot (4, 3.3, 1.8): the hand goes to (4, 4.573421, 0.347967), still the bone's 1.931321 from the toe, so the toe stays planted at its rest and the length-keeping pull changes nothing. The tap of 25 turns the toe 25 about X after its rest Rz 90, and the toe tip, 0.6 beyond and 0.1 below the toe, swings with it: (0, -0.1 cos25 - 0.6 sin25, -0.1 sin25 + 0.6 cos25) from the toe, so (4, 2.955798, 2.301523).
